name: Image Creating Engine
description: Built-in local image-generation backend for Dynamic Image Generator, rendering HTML/CSS to an image via the wkhtmltoimage binary.
project_description: Image Creating Engine is a submodule of Dynamic Image Generator that provides a local image-generation backend, selected as the "Built-in Image Engine" provider on the parent module's settings form. It exposes the service `image_creating_engine.generator` (class InbuiltImageGenerator), which takes rendered HTML and CSS, writes them to a temporary HTML file, and shells out to the `wkhtmltoimage` binary (found on common paths or via `which`) to produce a PNG or JPEG. The result is saved as a managed file and returned to the parent module for media creation. It also registers an `inbuilt` ImageGenerator plugin and ships a small logging helper (debug.php). Although its composer.json requires spatie/browsershot, the shipped service uses the wkhtmltoimage CLI rather than Browsershot/Puppeteer. Requires the wkhtmltopdf/wkhtmltoimage OS package to be installed on the server.
